subject.why: The foil TV-dinner tray is instantly recognisable, complete with compartments for turkey slices, peas, mashed potatoes with a melting pat of butter, and a berry dessert.

category.why: The tray rests on a plain, flat yellow surface in front of a smooth yellow gradient wall, perfectly adhering to category 2 composition.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, watermarks, borders, or characters.

framing.why: The object is centrally framed with generous margins on all sides and a readable, chunky silhouette.

colour.why: The palette is warm, bright, and juicy, with the yellow background contrasting nicely with the silver tray and rich food colours.

detail.why: Shapes are chunky and stylized without noisy micro-details, excessive clusters, or extra props.

style.why: The rendering matches the references with soft satin sheens, clean volumes, and smooth digital 3D finish without harsh outlines.

bg_colour.why: background is yellow (95% of the background); planned yellow
